messages.沈潜編成のトドメ役。味方と溜めた沈潜をS3の沈潜殺到で一気に発動させ、振動回数を: A finisher for Sinking teams. S3's Sinking Deluge cashes in the Sinking built by his allies, while spending his own Tremor Count turns S2 into a multi-target skill that spreads Sinking.
messages.S3「血を宿した香り」: Ⅲコイン的中時、対象の沈潜が6以上なら沈潜殺到。自分の: **S3 — Bloodsteeped Scent**: On hit, Coin Ⅲ triggers Sinking Deluge if the target has at least 6 Sinking Potency. With at least 10 Tremor Count on himself, it also deals additional damage equal to 30%/40% of the damage dealt. S3 gains 6 Tremor Count on use, so having at least 4 before use meets that condition. Losing the Clash costs him 20 SP. Slash-separated values indicate different Uptie tiers.
messages.S2「刹那の花風」: 戦闘開始時に自分の振動回数を6消耗して攻撃加重値3のスキル: **S2 — Moment's Floral Breeze**: At Combat Start, consumes 6 of his Tremor Count to become a skill with 3 Attack Weight. Each Coin inflicts 2 Sinking next turn. Gains +1 Coin Power if the main target has at least 6 Sinking Count.
messages.S1「萌え出る蕾」: 使用時に振動回数2/3を得る。Ⅱ・Ⅲコインで次のターンに沈: **S1 — Sprouting Bud**: Gains 2/3 Tremor Count on use. Coins Ⅱ and Ⅲ increase Sinking Count next turn.
messages.バトルパッシブ「満開」(怠惰×4・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 2名以上を攻撃すると: **Combat passive — Full Bloom (4 Sloth Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Deals +30% damage when attacking at least 2 targets.
messages.沈潜編成で使う。S2とS1を同じ敵に当てると、次のターンに沈潜の威力(S2)と回: Use him in a Sinking team. Hitting the same enemy with S2 and S1 sets up Sinking Potency from S2 and Count from S1 for the next turn. Add his allies' Sinking, then use S3 once the target has at least 6 Sinking Potency: Sinking Deluge deals SP damage equal to Sinking Count × Sinking Potency in one burst. Damage beyond the target's -45 SP floor becomes Gloom damage; against targets without SP, the entire amount becomes Gloom damage. Sinking is removed after the Deluge, so save it for a decisive moment. S1 and S3 build his own Tremor Count; with at least 6 at Combat Start, S2 gains Attack Weight and can benefit from Full Bloom's +30% by attacking multiple targets. Tremor Count falls by 1 at Turn End. Starting from 0, S3's +6 alone leaves only 5 next turn, and S1 alone also falls short. Build at least 7 beforehand, for example by using S3 and S1 in the same turn when he has multiple action slots. He struggles to supply Full Bloom's Sloth requirement alone, so bring allies with Sloth skills.
